headlines.title: 专家解读：不宜将央行操作机制改革举措和降息划等号
headlines.summary: 10月19日，中国人民银行行长潘功胜在2026金融街论坛年会开幕式上，明确银行间隔夜回购利率已成为货币政策调控的目标利率。市场权威专家表示，央行研究切换公开市场操作主力品种，属于货币政策框架改革的一项举措，不同于通常讲的货币政策降息加息，重点还是在不断完善利率调控的操作机制。国信证券经济研究所金融业首席分析师‌王剑认为，随着隔夜操作走向常态化，政策利率或从7天过渡至隔夜，但不宜和降息划等号。广发证券首席经济学家郭磊也提到，央行在持续完善自身的货币政策调控框架，一系列制度设计是一脉相承的，沿袭了向价格型框架转型的思路，市场也要避免将央行操作机制改革举措当作

headlines.title_en: Expert interpretation: central bank operational mechanism reform measures should not be equated with rate cuts
headlines.summary_en: On October 19, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng stated at the opening ceremony of the 2026 Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting that the interbank overnight repo rate has become the target rate for monetary policy regulation. Authoritative market experts said the PBOC's study of switching the main instrument of open market operations is a measure under monetary policy framework reform and differs from what is commonly called monetary policy rate cuts or hikes, with the focus still on continuously improving the operating mechanism for interest rate regulation. Wang Jian, chief analyst for the financial industry at Guosen Securities Economic Research Institute, believes that as overnight operations become more routine, the policy rate may transition from 7 days to overnight, but this should not be equated with a rate cut. headlines.title: 证监会法制司司长程合红：研究推进将《证券法》修改纳入下一届全国人大的立法规划
headlines.summary: 中国证监会首席律师、法制司司长程合红在2026金融街论坛年会“护航普惠包容金融新生态”主题论坛上表示，要强化系统观念，及时对专项金融法律进行配套修改完善。他指出，目前金融领域除了金融法在制定之外，同时金融稳定法、人民银行法、商业银行法、银行业监督管理法等法律的修改制定也已经列入了全国人大的立法议程。证监会正在开展证券法实施效果评估，并推进证券投资基金法修改工作。

headlines.title_en: Cheng Hehong, Director of the Legal Affairs Department of the CSRC: Studying and advancing the inclusion of Securities Law amendments in the legislative plan of the next National People's Congress
headlines.summary_en: Cheng Hehong, Chief Lawyer and Director-General of the Legal Affairs Department of the CSRC, said at the "Safeguarding an Inclusive New Financial Ecosystem" thematic forum of the 2026 Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting that systemic thinking should be strengthened and supporting revisions and improvements to specialized financial laws should be made in a timely manner. He noted that in addition to the ongoing formulation of the Financial Law, the revision and enactment of laws including the Financial Stability Law, the PBOC Law, the Commercial Bank Law, and the Banking Supervision and Administration Law have also been placed on the NPC's legislative agenda. The CSRC is carrying out an assessment of the implementation effects of the Securities Law and advancing the revision of the Securities Investment Fund Law.

headlines.summary:

Japan’s shift from an ultra-loose monetary policy to gradual normalisation of its interest rates was also likely to force investors to reconsider whether real estate assets were still attractive, they added.

headlines.summary_zh:
分析人士称，东京实施要求所有购房者申报国籍的规定，正引发投资者的担忧。
他们补充说，日本从超宽松货币政策转向利率逐步正常化，也可能迫使投资者重新考虑房地产资产是否仍具吸引力。

headlines.title: Growth in China’s factory-gate prices accelerates, but consumer inflation subdued
headlines.summary:
Growth in Chinese factory-gate prices continued to accelerate last month, while consumer price growth remained subdued despite Beijing’s efforts to shore up domestic demand and support the economy in meeting its annual growth target.
The producer price index (PPI) rose 5 per cent year on year in September, the highest rate since mid-2022, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Wednesday. It rose by 3.8 per cent in August.

headlines.title_zh: 中国工业生产者出厂价格涨幅加快，但消费者通胀低迷
headlines.summary_zh:
中国出厂价格上月继续加速上涨，而尽管北京方面努力提振国内需求并支持经济实现年度增长目标，消费者价格涨幅仍保持低迷。
数据显示，9月份生产者价格指数（PPI）同比上涨5%，为2022年年中以来的最高水平。

headlines.title: 何立峰会见金融监管总局国际咨询委员会委员时指出 中国将继续扩大金融高水平开放 加快建设金融强国
headlines.summary: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰19日晚在钓鱼台国宾馆会见金融监管总局国际咨询委员会委员时表示，中国正全面落实“十五五”规划纲要，将继续坚定不移扩大金融领域高水平对外开放，加快建设金融强国。欢迎更多外资金融机构来华投资兴业，深化对华合作，为中国式现代化建设提供高质量金融服务。金融监管总局国际咨询委员会委员表示，对中国深化金融改革开放充满期待，看好中国经济和金融发展前景，将持续扩大对华投资合作。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: He Lifeng, during a meeting with members of the International Advisory Committee of the National Financial Regulatory Administration, stated that China will continue to expand high-level financial opening and accelerate the building of a financial powerhouse
headlines.summary_en: He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, said on the evening of the 19th when meeting with the International Advisory Council of the National Financial Regulatory Administration at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse that China is fully implementing the outline of the 15th Five-Year Plan and will continue to unswervingly expand high-level opening-up in the financial sector and accelerate the building of a financial powerhouse. More foreign financial institutions are welcome to invest and do business in China, deepen cooperation with China, and provide high-quality financial services for Chinese-style modernization. Members of the International Advisory Council of the National Financial Regulatory Administration said they are full of expectations for China's deepening of financial reform and opening-up, are optimistic about the prospects of China's economy and financial development, and will continue to expand investment and cooperation with China. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 摩根大通向尼日利亚央行缴存保证金，接近获批进入尼日利亚市场
headlines.summary: 知情人士称，摩根大通已向尼日利亚中央银行缴存 500 亿奈拉（折合 3800 万美元），向着在这个非洲人口第一大国获取银行牌照再进一步。不愿具名的知情人士表示，这笔保证金是拿到审批前最后的监管要求之一，标志这家美国最大银行已做好准备；一旦申请获批，即可在尼日利亚开展商人银行业务。知情人士称，如果各项审批顺利，该行预计将在 2026 年底或 2027 年初取得牌照。但摩根大通未必一定能成功拿牌，最终决定权仍在尼日利亚央行。摩根大通拒绝发表评论，尼日利亚央行发言人暂未回应置评请求。

headlines.title_en: JPMorgan deposits margin with Nigeria's central bank, nearing approval to enter the Nigerian market
headlines.summary_en: People familiar with the matter said JPMorgan has deposited 50 billion naira (equivalent to $38 million) with the Central Bank of Nigeria, moving a step further toward obtaining a banking license in Africa's most populous country. The people, who declined to be named, said the deposit is one of the final regulatory requirements before approval and marks that the largest U.S. bank is ready to conduct merchant banking business in Nigeria once its application is approved. The people said that if all approvals proceed smoothly, the bank expects to obtain the license by the end of 2026 or early 2027. But JPMorgan may not necessarily succeed in obtaining the license, and the final decision still rests with the Central Bank of Nigeria. JPMorgan declined to comment, and a spokesperson for the Central Bank of Nigeria did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

headlines.title: 财政部拟发行2026年记账式贴现（六十八期）国债 招标面值总额550亿元
headlines.summary: 金十数据10月20日讯，财政部拟发行2026年记账式贴现（六十八期）国债。本期国债为期限182天的贴现债。本期国债竞争性招标面值总额550亿元，进行甲类成员追加投标。本期国债发行价格通过竞争性招标确定，以低于票面金额的价格贴现发行。本期国债自2026年10月28日开始计息，于2027年4月28日（节假日顺延）按面值偿还。招标时间2026年10月27日上午10:35至11:35。

headlines.title_en: The Ministry of Finance plans to issue 2026 book-entry discount (68th tranche) government bonds with a total face value of 55 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 20: The Ministry of Finance plans to issue 2026 book-entry discount (68th issue) government bonds. This issue is a 182-day discount bond. The total face value of the competitive tender for this issue is 55 billion yuan, with additional bidding by Class A members. The issue price will be determined through competitive tender and issued at a discount below par. Interest on this issue will begin accruing on October 28, 2026, and it will be redeemed at par on April 28, 2027 (postponed for holidays). The tender time is from 10:35 to 11:35 a.m. on October 27, 2026.

headlines.summary: 10月20日，重庆市统计局发布2026年前三季度重庆市经济运行情况。根据地区生产总值统一核算结果，前三季度重庆全市地区生产总值25711.51亿元，按不变价格计算，同比增长4.3%，高于上半年重庆市经济增速（4.2%）。其中，第一产业增加值1526.64亿元，同比增长3.9%；第二产业增加值8573.74亿元，同比增长1.7%；第三产业增加值15611.13亿元，同比增长5.8%。（澎湃新闻）

headlines.title_en: Chongqing's GDP for the first three quarters was 2.571151 trillion yuan, up 4.3% YoY
headlines.summary_en: On October 20, the Chongqing Municipal Statistics Bureau released the economic performance of Chongqing in the first three quarters of 2026. According to the unified accounting results of regional GDP, in the first three quarters, Chongqing's regional GDP was 2,571.151 billion yuan, up 4.3% year on year at constant prices, higher than the city's economic growth rate in the first half of the year (4.2%). Among them, the value added of the primary industry was 152.664 billion yuan, up 3.9% year on year; the value added of the secondary industry was 857.374 billion yuan, up 1.7% year on year; and the value added of the tertiary industry was 1,561.113 billion yuan, up 5.8% year on year. (The Paper)

headlines.title_en: Sichuan Province's GDP grew 4.9% in the first three quarters
headlines.summary_en: The Sichuan Provincial Statistics Bureau announced the economic performance of Sichuan Province in the first three quarters of 2026. According to the unified accounting results of regional GDP, Sichuan's GDP in the first three quarters of 2026 was 5,212.145 billion yuan, up 4.9% year on year at constant prices. By industry, the value added of the primary industry was 405.334 billion yuan, up 3.7%; the value added of the secondary industry was 1,791.626 billion yuan, up 5.2%; and the value added of the tertiary industry was 3,015.186 billion yuan, up 4.8%.
